verdict.rationale: Mintlify documents automations that run its agent automatically on repository pushes or connected integration events, as well as on a schedule. A redesign added pre-built automations for common use cases, so event-triggered actions are a first-party capability. Missing for 10: detail on how custom rules or conditions are defined beyond pre-built automations, action types other than running the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate content maintenance with Mintlify automations by running the agent on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events.
We redesigned automations for quicker setup with pre-built automations optimized for common use cases.
Assistant answers and automation updates cost credits.
